Fortnite
Apex Legends
Hey, I'm Deko.
I love IDA and Ghidra, so I had fun building a program that dumps Fortnite's memory into a `.bin` file, which I then analyzed with Ghidra to extract patterns, CPU instructions, and XOR keys. Thanks to that, I was able to create a kernel-driver-based dumper that can dump Fortnite's memory in around 25 minutes.
Join the Discord: discord.gg/YZJgRkEyVH
Enjoy the viewer.

Decryption routines and keys for Fortnite's encrypted name/object tables.
Decrypts/FName.hpp
#pragma once

#include "SDK/Basic.hpp"
#include "Offsets.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

namespace SDK
{
	namespace Names
	{
		inline uintptr_t Table()
		{
			return GetModuleBase() + Offsets::FNameTable;
		}

		inline uintptr_t Entry(uint32 Index)
		{
			uintptr_t table = Table();
			uint32 block = Index >> 16;
			uint32 offset = Index & 0xFFFF;
			uintptr_t block_ptr = Read<uintptr_t>(table + 8ull * (block + 2));
			if (!block_ptr) return 0;
			return block_ptr + 4ull * offset;
		}

		inline uint32 XorKey()
		{
			static uint32 key = 0;
			static bool ok = false;
			if (ok) return key;
			uintptr_t entry = Entry(0);
			if (!entry) return 0;
			uint16 hdr = Read<uint16>(entry + 4);
			if ((hdr >> 1) != 4 || (hdr & 1)) return 0;
			uint8 raw[4] = {};
			ReadBytes(entry + 6, raw, 4);
			const uint8 none[4] = { 'N', 'o', 'n', 'e' };
			uint8* kb = (uint8*)&key;
			for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
				kb[i] = (uint8)(raw[i] ^ 4 ^ none[i]);
			ok = true;
			return key;
		}

		inline std::string Get(uint32 Index)
		{
			uintptr_t entry = Entry(Index);
			if (!entry) return {};
			uint16 hdr = Read<uint16>(entry + 4);
			bool wide = (hdr & 1) != 0;
			uint32 len = hdr >> 1;
			if (len == 0 || len > 1024) return {};
			uint32 key4 = XorKey();
			if (wide)
			{
				uint32 byte_len = hdr & 0xFFFE;
				std::string out;
				out.resize(byte_len);
				if (!ReadBytes(entry + 6, out.data(), byte_len)) return {};
				for (uint32 i = 0; i < byte_len; i++)
					out[i] = (char)((uint8)out[i] ^ (uint8)(byte_len ^ ((uint8*)&key4)[i & 3]));
				std::string ascii;
				for (uint32 i = 0; i + 1 < byte_len; i += 2)
				{
					wchar_t wc = (wchar_t)(uint8)out[i] | ((wchar_t)(uint8)out[i + 1] << 8);
					if (!wc) break;
					if (wc < 0x80) ascii.push_back((char)wc);
				}
				return ascii;
			}
			std::string s(len, '\0');
			if (!ReadBytes(entry + 6, s.data(), len)) return {};
			for (uint32 i = 0; i < len; i++)
				s[i] = (char)((uint8)s[i] ^ (uint8)(len ^ ((uint8*)&key4)[i & 3]));
			return s;
		}
	}
}
Decrypts/GObjects.hpp
#pragma once

#include "SDK/Basic.hpp"
#include "Offsets.hpp"
#include <intrin.h>
#include <cstdint>

namespace SDK
{
	namespace Objects
	{
		constexpr uint64_t kHashMul = 0x2545F4914F6CDD1DULL;

		inline uint64_t MixKey(uint32_t k)
		{
			return k ^ (uint32_t)(k << 25) ^ (uint32_t)(((k ^ (k >> 15)) >> 12));
		}

		inline uint64_t BitSwapA(uint64_t v)
		{
			return ((v >> 1) ^ ((v >> 1) ^ (2 * v)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL);
		}

		inline uint64_t ShuffleCase0(uint64_t v)
		{
			uint64_t v8 = BitSwapA(v);
			uint64_t v9 = (v8 >> 2) ^ ((v8 >> 2) ^ (4 * v8)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
			uint64_t v10 = v9 >> 4;
			uint64_t t = v10 ^ (v10 ^ (16 * v9)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
			uint64_t v11 = (t >> 8) ^ ((t >> 8) ^ (t << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
			uint64_t swapped = (v11 << 32) | (v11 >> 32);
			uint64_t v12 = (swapped >> 1) ^ ((swapped >> 1) ^ (2 * swapped)) & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAULL;
			uint64_t t2 = (v12 >> 2) ^ ((v12 >> 2) ^ (4 * v12)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
			uint64_t v13 = t2 >> 4;
			uint64_t t3 = (v12 >> 2) ^ ((v12 >> 2) ^ (4 * v12)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
			uint64_t v14 = v13 ^ (v13 ^ (16 * t3)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
			uint64_t t4 = (v14 >> 8) ^ ((v14 >> 8) ^ (v14 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
			return _rotr64(t4, 32);
		}

		inline uint64_t ShuffleCase2(uint64_t v, uint32_t sub)
		{
			uint64_t v8 = BitSwapA(v);
			uint64_t v9 = (v8 >> 2) ^ ((v8 >> 2) ^ (4 * v8)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
			uint64_t v16 = (v9 >> 4) ^ ((v9 >> 4) ^ (16 * v9)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
			uint64_t t = (v16 >> 8) ^ ((v16 >> 8) ^ (v16 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
			return _rotr64(t, 32) - sub;
		}

		inline uint64_t ShuffleCase56(uint64_t v, uint32_t xor_val)
		{
			uint64_t v19 = (~(uint64_t)xor_val) ^ v;
			uint64_t v8 = BitSwapA(v19);
			uint64_t v9 = (v8 >> 2) ^ ((v8 >> 2) ^ (4 * v8)) & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCULL;
			uint64_t v21 = (v9 >> 4) ^ ((v9 >> 4) ^ (16 * v9)) & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ULL;
			uint64_t t = (v21 >> 8) ^ ((v21 >> 8) ^ (v21 << 8)) & 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00ULL;
			return _rotr64(t, 32);
		}

		inline uint64_t DecryptQword(uint64_t enc, uint64_t hash_slot, uint32_t h32)
		{
			uint32_t slot = (uint32_t)(hash_slot % 7);
			uint32_t sub = h32 + (uint32_t)hash_slot;
			uint32_t xor2 = h32 + 2u * (uint32_t)hash_slot;
			if (slot == 0) return ShuffleCase0(enc);
			if (slot == 1) return BitSwapA(enc) - sub;
			if (slot == 2) return ShuffleCase2(enc, sub);
			if (slot == 3) return BitSwapA((~(uint64_t)xor2) ^ enc);
			if (slot == 4) return enc - (uint64_t)sub - (uint64_t)xor2;
			return ShuffleCase56(enc, xor2);
		}

		inline uintptr_t DecryptHeader()
		{
			uintptr_t key_addr = GetModuleBase() + Offsets::GObjectKey;
			uintptr_t table_addr = GetModuleBase() + Offsets::GObjectTable;
			uint32_t key_val = Read<uint32_t>(key_addr);
			uint64_t mixed = MixKey(key_val);
			uint64_t prod = kHashMul * mixed;
			uint64_t hash = prod % 7;
			uint32_t h32 = (uint32_t)(prod >> 32);
			uint64_t enc = Read<uint64_t>(table_addr + (2 * hash + 16) * 4);
			return (uintptr_t)(DecryptQword(enc, hash, h32) ^ key_val);
		}

		inline int32 Num()
		{
			uintptr_t header = DecryptHeader();
			if (!header) return 0;
			return Read<int32>(header + 0x14);
		}

		inline uintptr_t Get(int32 Index)
		{
			uintptr_t header = DecryptHeader();
			if (!header) return 0;
			uintptr_t chunks = Read<uintptr_t>(header);
			if (!chunks) return 0;
			uintptr_t chunk = Read<uintptr_t>(chunks + 8ull * (uint32_t)(Index >> 16));
			if (!chunk) return 0;
			uintptr_t item = chunk + 0x18ull * (uint32_t)(Index & 0xFFFF);
			return Read<uintptr_t>(item);
		}
	}
}

#include <cstdint>
#include <intrin.h>
 
constexpr std::uintptr_t uworld_encrypted_rva = 0x1A9E6268;
 
template <typename Read>
std::uintptr_t get_uworld(std::uintptr_t image_base, Read&& read)
{
const std::uint64_t encrypted =
read.template operator()std::uint64_t(
image_base + uworld_encrypted_rva
);
 
const std::uint64_t decoded =
    _byteswap_uint64(
        encrypted ^ UINT64_C(0x0000000001047ADE)
    ) - UINT64_C(0x0803A0EA);
 
return static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(decoded);
 
}
